name: COMP101_L4_Functions

relation_semantics.isRequiredBy: Inverse of dependsOn (OWL). A-Box is forward-only.
relation_semantics.usesConcept: Subject relies on Concept or Pattern. Range=Concept|Pattern.
relation_semantics.isUsedBy: Inverse of usesConcept (OWL). A-Box is forward-only.
relation_semantics.implementedBy: Concept is realized by a ConceptCarrier (LanguageConstruct/Operator/BuiltInFunction/DataType). OWL domain=Concept, range=ConceptCarrier. Never Algorithm subjects (use usesConstruct for Algorithm→carrier).
relation_semantics.implementsConcept: Inverse of implementedBy (OWL). A-Box asserts only implementedBy.
relation_semantics.usesConstruct: Algorithm employs a ConceptCarrier (e.g. def, return). OWL domain=Algorithm, range=ConceptCarrier. Never retarget to a Concept object.
relation_semantics.constructUsedBy: Inverse of usesConstruct (OWL). A-Box asserts only usesConstruct.
relation_semantics.producesType: BuiltInFunction|Concept → DataType (builtins and Function Output/Return Value, incl NoneType).
relation_semantics.throwsError: Subject is associated with an ErrorType from incorrect use. Domain owl:Thing; Concept and LanguageConstruct subjects allowed. Range must stay ErrorType.
relation_semantics.isThrownBy: Inverse of throwsError (OWL). A-Box asserts only throwsError.
relation_semantics.methodOf: Method belongs to a DataType. Unused in this lecture A-Box.
relation_semantics.contrastsWith: Alternatives/confused peers (e.g. Local↔Global Variable). Not for param/arg or def/call sequencing.
relation_semantics.taughtIn: Entity introduced in the object Lecture. External-evidence gated for the judge.
relation_semantics.teaches: Inverse of taughtIn (OWL). A-Box asserts only taughtIn.

competency_questions.question: Which concepts are taught in L04?
Which subjects accept a data type?
Which data types does Function Input accept?
Which algorithms use the Early-Return Guard Pattern?

authoring_policy: Lecture 4. Algorithm = named computational procedure wrapped in functions (not greeting/area demos). Patterns: Helper Function, Early-Return Guard. acceptsType/producesType cover BuiltInFunction|Concept.
